post.description: Uploads a new version of the file with the specified file ID. File name and id won't be changed after this operation.

200.description: Successfully uploaded new version. Returns id of the file.

put.description:
Replaces the old file with file ID from request with the new one with new id. The update file 

 operation comprises two requests to BOX: delete file and upload a new file. The name of the uploaded file will be 

    the same as the file in request.

200.description: Successfully updated. Returns new id of replaced file.

delete.description: Deletes the file with the file ID from the request.

post.description: Creates a copy of the file with the specified file ID in the target folder.

parameters.name: targetFolderId
parameters.description: Target folder identifier where the file will be copied

parameters.name: newName
parameters.description: The new name for copied file. If parameter empty or null then original name will be used.

201.description: Successfully copied. Returns id of copied file.

example.error: A file with the same name already exists in the target folder

post.description: Uploads a new file in the folder with the folder ID from the request. The name of uploaded file will be the same as the file in request.

201.description: Successfully created. Returns id of created file.

post.description: Creates a folder in the folder with the folder ID from the request.

201.description: Successfully created. Returns id of created folder.

patch.description: Updates the folder's name. Returns the same folder ID from the request.

200.description: Successfully updated. Returns id of updated folder.

delete.description: Removes the folder with folder ID from the request. Removes all contents.

modifiedBy.description: The name of a person who modified this file recently.

modifiedAt.description: The date and time when the file was last updated on Box.

parentFolderId.description: The ID of the folder where this file is located.

folderId.description: ID of the folder where the file will be located.
The ID of a folder where the new one will be created.

IdResponse.description: ID of folder or file on BOX.

modifiedBy.description: The name of a person who changed the folder's content recently

modifiedAt.description: The date and time when the folder's content was last updated on Box.

parentFolderId.description: The ID of the folder where this folder is located. Could be null if it's root folder.
